name: A Serene Trip
source:
Adelaide is a penniless space architecture student. She has found a job on the cargo ship Serene to pay for her next year of studies. She is counting on a quiet month-long journey before she can meet with her family again.

But the universe seems to conspire against her: between vampire clan wars, the mosses' grudge against the captain, a traveling pod of space whales, combative doriphores crew-mates, and sheer bad luck, she is in for a challenging trip.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/772884434/a-serene-trip-a-strategy-visual-novel-in-space]Kickstarter[/url]]
translation:
阿德莱德是一名身无分文的太空建筑学生。她在Serene号货船上找到了一份工作，以支付明年的学费。她期待着为期一个月的安静旅程，然后才能再次与家人见面。

但宇宙似乎在与她作对：吸血鬼部落的战争、苔藓对船长的怨恨、一群太空鲸鱼、好斗的多利佛尔船员伙伴以及纯粹的坏运气，她将踏上充满挑战的旅程。

[来自[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/772884434/a-serene-trip-a-strategy-visual-novel-in-space]Kickstarter[/url]]
